This '''Jedi''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its final [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. His [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Kento Marek]], outlived him by several years following the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==Biography==
This individual began [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during infancy as with all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the era. Studying at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], this Jedi eventually passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. Further pursuits of knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] skill earned this individual the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]. It was at this point in life that this individual spotted [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|initiate]] [[Kento Marek]] and took him as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="SW:TFU" />

Training Marek to Knighthood, this Jedi Master joined the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|general]] fighting the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], this Jedi Master was hunted down and [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SW:TFU" />

Learning of his former master's death, Marek and his Jedi wife, [[Mallie Marek|Mallie]], fled to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and went into hiding with their child, [[Galen Marek|Galen]]. Remaining true to their teachings, the couple attempted to assist the local [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] repel the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] onslaught following the Galactic Empire's initial enslavement runs on the planet. It wasn't long before Mallie Marek fell in battle, and eventually in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] Kento Marek [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|shared the same fate]] as his master.

When Vader hunted down Kento Marek, he sensed a presence far more powerful then Kento nearby. Assuming it was Marek's master, Vader demanded his whereabouts. Marek replied that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] blinded him from realizing he had already slain his master [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before. Vader replied that Marek would share his fate.<ref name="DB-Starkiller Darth Vader's Secret Apprentice">{{DB|character|starkiller|Starkiller (Darth Vader's Secret Apprentice)}}</ref>
